nc.description: A grey mechanical arm with an open, cylindrical claw is positioned around a glowing white sphere.
A mechanical arm attached to several wavy tubes holds a flat rectangular object next to two faceted cylinders.
A close-up shows a light grey mechanical hinge joint consisting of interlocking prongs connected by a central pin.
A monochromatic 3D rendering displays an abstract mechanical assembly featuring radiating beams attached to a central block, a ringed shaft, a spoked wheel, and a suspended sphere.
A variety of light grey mechanical parts, geometric shapes, and textured objects are neatly arranged on a white surface around a central clamp-like assembly.

vc.description: A close-up shows a mechanical assembly with a toothed ring and metal linkages attached to a ribbed outer sleeve that is partially cut away to reveal a textured white inner core.
A white, ribbed cap on a cylindrical body is connected to a flexible, segmented strap via a hinged lever mechanism.
A grey mechanical device featuring two suction cup bases, textured straps, and dual hand cranks is displayed against a white background.
A light grey mechanical assembly features a central handle connecting two hinged arms to a gear mechanism, with a small container suspended underneath by thin wires.
A central gear mechanism is surrounded by molded grey casing parts, handles, and piles of small grey pellets arranged on a white surface.
